title: Wagyu mod
description: Ever dreamed of haveing wagyu in minecraft? No ? but now you can
body:
Wagyu Craft

Turn ordinary cows into the most luxurious beef in Minecraft.

Features

Wagyu Craft adds a completely new way to obtain legendary Wagyu beef — and yes, your cows need to relax first.

Step 1 — Brew Beer

To create beer, you first need Yeast.

Yeast can only be obtained by trading with the new villager profession:

Brewer Villager
Yeast unlocks only at the Master Trade
Expect expensive trades and lots of grinding

Once you finally get Yeast, craft Beer using:

2 Wheat
1 Water Bucket
1 Glass Bottle
1 Yeast
Step 2 — Relax the Cow

Find a cow and give it a comfortable place to stay.

For the best results:

Keep the cow inside a small area (recommended max size: 6x6 blocks)
Place a Jukebox
Play music so the cow can relax

While the music is playing, give the cow the Beer.

A relaxed cow is a happy cow.

Step 3 — Obtain Wagyu

Once the cow is fully relaxed...
well...
you know what to do.

Defeat the cow to obtain:

Raw Wagyu

Cook it in a furnace to create:

Cooked Wagyu
Effects

Eating Cooked Wagyu grants powerful positive effects, making it one of the best foods in the game.

Because luxury beef should feel luxurious.

Notes
Designed for survival progression
Beer brewing is intentionally expensive
Inspired by the idea of highly pampered Wagyu cattle
